review.intent_summary: Expose how much history supports each comparison while allowing statistical point triggers only after calibration.

criteria.criterion: Short series return reference evidence and an insufficient_history status instead of inventing calibrated findings.
Provisional residual scores can be reported but do not trigger point-anomaly episodes.
Completed calibration provides a frozen residual center and sample scale for later standardized residuals.
Evidence records the observed value, expectation, calibration support, and numerical criterion responsible for a trigger.

verification_evidence: Executed assertion checks through .venv/Scripts/python.exe: short history retained three reference-only samples without scores or triggers; a provisional score of 2 exceeded threshold 1 without creating an episode.

Executed numerical output inspection: calibration center 2 and sample scale 1 remained frozen across later scores 4 and 5; both samples recorded calibrated maturity, three calibration samples, observed/expected values, and point triggers against method threshold 3.
